faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do my customers need to install an app?
faq.a1: No. They scan the QR code with their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser.
faq.q2: What if the network is weak?
faq.a2: Pages are very light and photos are compressed. After the first visit, the menu works offline. A “data saver” mode hides photos.
faq.q3: How long does it take to start?
faq.a3: A few minutes: create your business, add your dishes or products (the “Suggest” button proposes translations), then print your QR codes.
faq.q4: How do I pay for the subscription?
faq.a4: In CFA francs, by Orange Money, Moov Money or cash. The 30-day Pro trial needs no payment.
faq.q5: Can I change my prices at any time?
faq.a5: Yes, as often as you like. You can also mark a dish “sold out today”: it comes back automatically the next day.
faq.a6: Each business only sees its own data, connections are encrypted and we sell no data. See our privacy policy.

scan.intro: Customers can show you their order on their phone.
scan.s1: The customer taps « Show to the server »: big screen with the table and dishes.
scan.s2: Scan the QR code on their screen with your phone.
scan.s3: The order opens on your side: confirm it.

kitchen.title: Use the kitchen display
kitchen.intro: Dishes to prepare show up by station.
kitchen.s1: A confirmed order arrives on the kitchen display.
kitchen.s2: Tap a dish when you start: it turns « Cooking ».
kitchen.s3: Tap « All ready » when everything is done.
kitchen.s4: The floor is notified right away.

rc.title: Help a customer who can’t scan
rc.intro: The RC number opens the same menu as the QR code.
rc.s1: Show the customer the RC number printed under the QR code (e.g. RC-K7M3P).
rc.s2: They go to restocool.com/c and type the number.
rc.s3: The menu opens, already at the right table.

location.title: Business location
location.hint: In Burkina, people find places with Google Maps. Save your location: customers get a “Directions” button on your menu.
location.savedGps: Location saved from the phone (accuracy ± {m} m)
location.savedLink: Location saved from a Google Maps link
location.confirmTitle: Are you at your business right now?
location.confirmText: Your phone's current position will become your business location. Customers will see it so they can find you. Only do this if you are on site.
location.linkLabel: Or paste a Google Maps link
location.linkHelp: In Google Maps, find your business (or your position), tap “Share”, then “Copy link”.

error.no_coordinates: This link has no position in it. Copy the link from “Share” in Google Maps.
error.too_imprecise: The position is too imprecise. Go outside, turn on GPS and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.noGps: Couldn't get this phone's position. Turn on location, or paste a Google Maps link.
error.denied: Location access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings, or paste a Google Maps link.

roles.title: Roles and access
roles.intro: Everyone has a role. Tick what each role can open in the app; changes apply right away to everyone who has it. You can also create your own roles.
roles.introReadOnly: The business's roles and what they allow. Only the owner can change them.
roles.noAccess: No app access: this person only checks in and out.
roles.createHint: Type the name you use (for example “Grill chef” or “Head cashier”) and choose its access.
roles.name: Role name

err.invalid: Check the role name (2 to 40 characters).
err.forbidden: Only the owner can make this change.
err.duplicate: A role already has this name.
err.inUse: People still have this role: give them another role first.

areaHints.service: Front desk: confirm, take an order, mark served.
areaHints.cancel: Cancel an order and give a discount.
areaHints.soldOut: Mark a dish sold out today, with a note.
areaHints.menu: Add and edit dishes, prices and photos.
areaHints.seats: Tables, rooms, QR codes and print kits.
areaHints.staff: Add people, their role, PIN and check-in. Lead role: only the owner gives it.

alerts.title: Needs attention
alerts.allGood: All good: nothing is waiting for a decision.
alerts.waiting: {n, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} been waiting over 5 minutes
alerts.ready: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} ready to serve
alerts.locked: {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} locked (too many wrong PINs)
alerts.soldOut: {n, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} sold out or unavailable
alerts.unpublished: Your menu isn't published yet: customers can't see it
alerts.noLocation: Add your business location so customers can find you
alerts.join: {n, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} waiting to join the team
alerts.noPhoto: Add a photo of your front or interior: customers will recognise you faster

ranking.title: Personnel ranking
ranking.empty: No personnel yet. Add your teams in Personnel.
ranking.how: Scoring: order served = {served} pts; confirmed, prepared or taken = {handled} pts; hour present = {hour} pt; day present = {day} pts; app action = 1 pt (up to {cap}).

history.title: Order history
history.intro: Every order, who handled it, and the total served. Export it for Excel or Google Sheets.
history.truncated: Only the 300 most recent are shown: narrow the filters or export.

scan.title: Scan
scan.intro: Point at a customer's “Show the server” QR to open their order, the check-in QR, or a table QR.
scan.hint: Put the QR code inside the frame: it opens by itself.
scan.unknown: This QR code is not a RestoCool code:

phase.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the RC number below.
phase.nocamera: No camera on this device. Type the RC number below.
phase.unknown: QR code not recognised. Try again.

scan.roundIntro: {route}: go row by row and scan each traveler's “Show the hostess” code. The camera stays open.
scan.roundAdded: ✓ Added: {n} in the round. Go to the next traveler.
scan.roundNotOrder: This QR code is not a traveler's order.

join.title: Join the team
join.intro: Do you work at {name}? Enter your details: the manager will confirm you as part of the team.
join.name: Full name
join.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. You use it to check in and out. Don't share it.
join.privacy: Your name and phone are only visible to the business's managers.
join.invalidTitle: This QR code is no longer valid
join.invalidText: Ask the manager to show you the new “Invite my team” QR code.

error.invalid: Check your name (at least 3 characters) and your PIN (4 to 6 digits).
error.phone: Invalid phone number. Example: 70 00 00 00, or with the +226 code.
error.full: Too many requests waiting for this business. Ask the manager to handle them, then try again.
error.closed: This number is already in the team, or this QR code is no longer valid.
error.too_many: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.

join.noRequest: No request on this phone. Scan the manager's “Invite my team” QR code.
join.pendingText: Thank you {name}! {business} now needs to confirm your request. Keep this page open: it updates by itself.
join.acceptedHint: Remember this number: with your PIN, you use it to check in and out.
join.declinedText: {business} did not accept the request. Talk to the manager.

invite.title: Invite my team
invite.intro: Show this QR code to the new person. They scan it with their phone, enter their name and number, then you accept their request.
invite.qrLabel: QR code to join the team
invite.step1: The person scans this QR code with their phone camera.
invite.step2: They enter their full name and phone, and choose a PIN.
invite.step3: You get the request: choose their role and accept. They get their staff number right away.
invite.regenerateConfirm: Create a new QR code? The old one will stop working.
invite.safety: Don't post this QR code publicly: every request still needs your approval.

owner.title: {n, plural, one {# person wants} other {# people want}} to join the team
owner.intro: Check that you know the person, choose their role, then accept. They get their staff number right away.
owner.addStep1: Show this QR code to the person: they scan it with their phone.
owner.addStep2: They enter their full name and phone and choose a PIN.
owner.addStep3: Their request appears here: choose their role and accept. They get their staff number right away.

prompt.one: {name} is asking to join the team
prompt.many: {name} and {n, plural, one {# other person} other {# other people}} are asking to join the team

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: The business's tablets and phones where personnel log in with their PIN, with no account or email. A login lasts at most {shiftHours} h (one shift) and locks after {idleMinutes} min without activity.
devices.authorizeHint: Do it on the tablet or phone that stays at the business (floor, kitchen, cash desk). Give it a name to recognise it.
devices.name: Device name
devices.switchHint: Switch to team mode: your account signs out of this device, and each person logs in with their PIN.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? It will stop working and whoever is logged in on it will be logged out.

ok.revoked: Device revoked: it no longer works.

err.invalid: Give the device a name (2 to 40 characters).
err.forbidden: You don't have access to devices.
err.plan: PIN login on tablets is included in the Pro and Business plans.

poste.title: Team device
poste.locked: Session locked. The next person can log in.
poste.lockedIdle: Session locked after a while without activity.
poste.noTeam: Nobody has a PIN yet. The manager adds people in Personnel.
poste.footer: Shared tablet: always lock when you leave.
poste.notAuthorizedText: The owner or a manager signs in once on this device, then goes to Personnel → Devices → “Authorise this device”.

error.unknown: Profile not found or without a PIN. Ask the manager.
error.locked: Too many errors: profile locked for {m} min.
error.device: This device is no longer authorised. Ask the manager.
error.too_many: Too many tries. Please wait a moment.

transport.title: Buses & itineraries
transport.intro: Your buses with their seat maps and QR codes, and your itineraries with the hostesses assigned.
transport.noBus: No buses yet. Add one below.
transport.editLayoutHint: Seats whose number still exists keep their printed QR code. Not possible during a trip.
transport.addBusHint: Give the number of rows and seats on each side of the aisle: the map draws itself. Most buses have 2 seats on each side.
transport.setupBuses: {n, plural, one {# bus added} other {# buses added}}. You can add more now or later.
transport.routesIntro: Your lines (Ouaga → Bobo, Ouaga → Koudougou…). Assign hostesses to each itinerary: they will see those trips.
transport.noTeam: First add your personnel in Personnel.

ok.busCreated: Bus added: {n} seats, each with its QR code.

err.tripOpen: This bus is on a trip: end the trip first.
err.invalid: Check the numbers (at least 1 row and 1 seat per row) or the cities (different from and to).
err.forbidden: You don't have access to this action.

bus.name: Bus name or number
bus.backHint: Seats on the last row, from side to side (0 if none).
bus.door: Middle door (one row without seats on one side)

print.hint: {bus}: {n} cards for the seat backs, plus the bus QR.
print.busCard: For the door or the ticket: it opens the seat map and the menu.

trips.title: Trips
trips.intro: Start your bus's trip: travelers can then order from their seat. On arrival, end the trip to free all the seats.
trips.noBus: No buses yet. The manager adds buses in “Buses & itineraries”.
trips.endConfirm: End the trip? All seats will be freed for the next departure.
trips.noRoute: No itinerary is assigned to you. Ask the manager.

err.busBusy: This bus is already on a trip.
err.notAssigned: You are not assigned to this itinerary.
err.invalid: Check the itinerary and departure time.
err.forbidden: You don't have access to trips.

round.roundTitle: Round: {n, plural, one {# order scanned} other {# orders scanned}}
round.roundDone: All the round's orders are confirmed.
round.doubles: Seats {seats}: orders from several phones. Check the tickets.
round.okConfirmed: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to confirm} one {# order confirmed} other {# orders confirmed}}. Travelers see “Order received”.
round.okServed: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to serve} one {# order served} other {# orders served}}.

publicTransport.showWaiterHint: Show this selection to the hostess to order.
publicTransport.invalidQr: This QR code is no longer valid. Ask the hostess or choose your seat.
publicTransport.orderError: The order didn't go through. Try again, or show your selection to the hostess.
publicTransport.orderQrHint: The hostess scans this code to receive your order.

welcome.subject: Welcome to RestoCool, {business} 🎉
welcome.preheader: Your business is ready. Here is how to get started with RestoCool.
welcome.tagline: Your menu, your orders, your tables. Simple.
welcome.intro: Thank you for joining RestoCool. “{business}” is now part of the platform designed in Burkina, for Burkina’s businesses. Your menu, your orders and your team are managed in one place, from your phone or a tablet.
welcome.rcText: This is your business’s identifier. It is printed under your QR codes, and customers can also type it at restocool.com/c to open your menu.
welcome.offerText: Every Pro feature is free until online payment opens. Make the most of it to go digital without paying anything.
welcome.step1: Complete your menu: dishes, prices in FCFA and photos (a few minutes are enough).
welcome.step2: Print your QR codes and place them on the tables and at the counter.
welcome.step2Transport: Add your buses and itineraries, then print the seat QR codes.
welcome.step3: Invite your team: each person scans your team QR and gets their staff number once you approve.
welcome.f1: 📱 A digital menu in French, English and Chinese, with photos, fast even on small phones and slow networks.
welcome.f2: 🛎️ Live orders: customers order from their seat, the kitchen and servers follow everything in real time.
welcome.f3: 🪑 Tables, private rooms, counter, takeaway: every order reaches the right place, with no mix-ups.
welcome.f3Transport: 🚌 VIP buses: a seat map, travelers order from their seat and the hostess confirms her round in one tap.
welcome.f4: 👥 A team without email: PIN login on the tablet, a staff number for everyone and check-in times.
welcome.f5: 💬 WhatsApp built in: takeaway orders, contact and menu sharing in one tap.
welcome.f6: 📊 A clear dashboard: today’s sales, best-selling dishes and your team’s ranking.
welcome.whyText: No more worn-out paper menus or misheard orders. Customers see your dishes in photos, order without waiting, and you stay in control of every table. Every shared menu also spreads the word about your business.
welcome.help: A question? Just reply to this email and we will help you.
welcome.footer: RestoCool, a TIBLOGICS product · restocool.com. You are receiving this email because you just created a business on RestoCool.

seo.transportDescription: {name}: the on-board menu with prices in CFA francs. Order from your seat.

seo.menuDescriptionOwn: {name} in {city}: {text} Menu and prices in CFA francs.

orderLink.subtitle: A customer’s order
orderLink.signInText: Sign in: the order opens right away and you can take care of the customer.
orderLink.signIn: Sign in and open the order
orderLink.notMemberTitle: This account is not part of {name}’s team
orderLink.notMemberText: Only team members can open this business’s orders. If you have another account for this restaurant, sign in with it.
orderLink.joinText: A manager must add you to the team first.
orderLink.join1: Ask your boss or manager for the “Join the team” QR.
orderLink.join2: Scan it, then enter your name, phone and a PIN code.
orderLink.join3: As soon as the manager accepts, you get your staff number and can scan orders.
